text:
Rina (CS): working on a one-page 'Priming Playkit' customers can run before big ramps. aim: reduce renewal risk and smooth onboarding. quick review?
Ethan (CS Ops): love it. main asks: make the checklist copy-paste friendly and include a tiny decision rule for tenant scale.
Rina (CS): thinking: 4 blocks — quick smoke (prefill), batching defaults, streaming fallback, renewal signals. each block should be one short command or config.
Brett (SRE): ops notes: show safe backoff pseudocode, cap concurrent prefill threads, and recommend tenant-level cache TTLs. example: "prefill_ttl: 2h for high-churn, 12h for low-churn".
Nina (Solutions Eng): add two small code snippets: curl prefill and SDK batching config. curl example: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/prefill -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"tenant":"ACME","keys":["welcome"]}'`
Omar (PM): include renewal-risk thresholds we trigger on: yellow if error_rate >= 2% for 12h, red if error_rate >= 3% for 6h OR p95 latency > 2x SLO for 6h. map to CS actions.
Rina (CS): i'll add a tiny escalation ladder: green = monitor, yellow = schedule enablement check, red = immediate triage + optional model downgrade. include sample Slack alert: `@cs-team TENANT123 -> RED: p95 x2 SLO`
Ethan (CS Ops): batching guidance: recommend client-side batch window 10-80ms for low-latency apps; 150-400ms for throughput jobs. pasteable SDK JSON: `{\n  \"batch\":{\"max_delay_ms\":100,\"max_tokens\":1500}\n}`
Brett (SRE): streaming: prefer chunked streaming. fallback flow text: "stream -> resume up to 2x -> serve cached snippet + enqueue async gen". also add metric keys to request from customers: `stream.resume_attempts`, `stream.fail_rate`.
Nina (Solutions Eng): QA snippet for prefill smoke test that CS can run: `POST /v1/prefill/smoke -> expect 200 + sample tokens returned` plus expected telemetry query example.
Telemetry Bot: telemetry export created: dashboard link https://telemetry.redwood.example/d/priming-playkit -> includes p95, error_rate, prefill.success_rate.
Rina (CS): final bit: consent blurb for telemetry sharing. short line: "share anonymized runtime metrics with Redwood for onboarding help; opt-in required (we provide template)".
Omar (PM): please add a one-line recovery action: if RED >4h recommend temporary routing to lighter model variant to protect UX.
Rina (CS): great — i'll assemble the one-pager + 1-line renewal checklist (warmpool enabled, prefill smoke ok, telemetry consent) and post in #customer-success tomorrow AM. thanks all :thumbsup:
